name: tags-input
blurb: Tag input with inline editing and Add-via-Enter/comma functionality.
description: A controlled tags input that displays tags as clickable pills, supports inline editing, and allows adding tags by pressing Enter or comma.
use_when: Building forms for skills, interests, or any list of string values where users need to add, remove, and edit items.
avoid_when: When tags are read-only or when a different UI pattern is preferred.
a11y: Tags are clickable for editing, delete button uses click handler. Interactive elements work but lack explicit aria labels.
